capacity.thresholds_source: frozen 2026-10-29 from m-baseline-r1/r2 (26102d1cb): e2e p95 = 3 x max isolated sequential p95 plus declared external time (wf-io: wf-noop + 3 x 200 ms; agents: 500 ms per model call, chat 1 call, tools 2), rounded up to 0.5 s; queue p95 2 s workflows, 5 s agents

4gb-capacity.description: 4 decimal GB whole-runtime envelope (4,000,000,000 bytes, 3.725 GiB), with the same 4 CPU quota and per-component CPU limits as M. Includes API, client, both permitted workers, CNPG Postgres, Pooler and Redis; excludes build jobs, load generation, fake providers, object storage and cluster infrastructure. Memory fit does not establish a worker-memory optimization or sustained capacity.

capacity.thresholds_source: frozen 2026-10-29 from m-baseline-r1/r2 (26102d1cb): e2e p95 = 3 x max isolated sequential p95 plus declared external time (wf-io: wf-noop + 3 x 200 ms; agents: 500 ms per model call, chat 1 call, tools 2), rounded up to 0.5 s; queue p95 2 s workflows, 5 s agents

m-capacity.description: Envelope M capacity search: open-loop arrivals, fake model with a declared 500 ms per call, fake external API with 200 ms per call. Gate thresholds are provisional until frozen from the M class baseline (recorded in capacity.thresholds_source).

declaration.scope: Eight finite SDK-heavy diagnostic windows, serial by profile and ordered control2/control4/candidate2/candidate4. No sustainable-capacity, maximum-rate, density, cold-start, or storage-retention claim.

steady_state_worker_policy_amendment.reason: compare two warm workers under each canonical envelope; component resources, quota, PgBouncer defaults, workload, and rate stay otherwise canonical

limits: The 2/s, 120-second cells contain about 240 offered arrivals; they do not satisfy the frozen capacity confirmation's 400-observation minimum and must not be reported as a passing capacity rate.
Each rate is one ordered control/candidate observation in retained within-profile state; there is no randomized repetition or maximum-rate search.
Sampled resource peaks are lower bounds. Storage, counters, and execution outcomes remain separate measurements.
The worker policy is intentionally amended to warm=max=2; resources, quotas, PgBouncer defaults, and both canonical profile allocations remain recorded in the declaration.

post_measurement_source_delta.scope: Consolidated the older draft table repair repository savepoint/ValueError contract; removed redundant HTTP create mapper. No pool, config, audit, wake, document-operation or other hot-path source changed. Metadata creation was outside timed workload; the same table was precreated in both arms. Final focused tests and API quality are recorded separately.

post_measurement_validation.astra_review: Exact repository savepoint, duplicate ValueError, usable losing transaction and redundant REST mapper removal approved; no hot-path rebenchmark required.

scope: Eight serial finite SDK-heavy diagnostics across canonical 4gb-capacity and m-capacity envelopes. Results are before/after observations, not capacity certificates, tenant-density claims, cold-start measures, or storage-retention measurements.
